items.title: 10.8 Emf par asar karne wale awamil (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Faraday ka qanoon, epsilon = -N delta phi/delta t, dikhata hai ke induced emf ki miqdar kin cheezon par munhasir hai.

items: Magnetic flux ki tabdeeli ki sharah: Faraday ka qanoon batata hai ke magnetic flux mein tez tabdeeliyan zyada induced emf deti hain.
Coil ke turns ki tadaad: Faraday ke qanoon ke mutabiq induced emf coil ke turns ki tadaad ke bhi tanasub mein hai; zyada turns zyada induced emf dete hain.
Nisbati speed: magnetic field se coil (ya conductor) ki speed bhi induced emf ki miqdar par asar karti hai; tez speed magnetic flux ki tabdeeli ki sharah barhati hai, jis se induced emf barhti hai.

blocks.caption: Induced emf par asar karne wale awamil
rows: Coil aur magnet ki nisbati speed

blocks.prompt: 0.2 T field mein chalti dhaati rod ke siron par 0.8 V emf hai; baqi awamil wahi rakh kar 2.4 V ke liye kitni field chahiye (numerical 10.4)? 4.0 cm radius aur 1.0 milliohm resistance ka copper chhalla amudi field mein hai jo 5 x 10^-3 s mein 0.2 T se 0.4 T ho jati hai; current nikalein (numerical 10.5).
Faraday ka qanoon aur Lenz ka qanoon bayan aur wazeh kijiye, aur induced emf par asar karne wale awamil bataiye (comprehensive question 10.3).
blocks.explanation: Faraday ka qanoon: N loops wali coil mein induced ausat emf us se magnetic flux ki tabdeeli ki sharah ke manfi ke barabar hai, emf = -N delta phi/delta t. Lenz ka qanoon: induced current hamesha us tabdeeli ki mukhalifat karta hai jis ne use paida kiya, isi liye manfi alamat hai aur isi liye electrical energy banane ke liye kaam karna parta hai. Emf flux ki tabdeeli ki sharah, turns ki tadaad aur coil aur magnet ki nisbati speed ke saath barhti hai.

items: Induced emf barhti hai (1) flux ki tabdeeli ki sharah, (2) turns ki tadaad (tanasub mein) aur (3) field se coil ya conductor ki nisbati speed ke saath.
